    Health checks

    How this forecast works
    • Starting body fat comes from your BMI and age (Deurenberg equation), adjusted for South Asians, who carry more fat at the same BMI, and for the build you picked.
    • Each exercise feeds sets to its main and helper muscles. Growth follows a dose response that levels off around 12–20 hard sets per muscle per week.
    • Growth is fastest in your first year and slows each year after. It's limited by protein (full effect near 1.6 g/kg), calories, sleep and age.
    • Fat changes with your calorie balance (about 7,700 kcal per kg). Maintenance is recalculated every week as your weight changes (Mifflin-St Jeor).
    • Health thresholds use WHO Asian BMI cut-offs (23 overweight, 25 obese) and the IDF South Asian waist cut-off for men (90 cm). Waist is estimated from body fat with the Relative Fat Mass formula.
    • Food values are approximate for typical home servings. Genetics, sleep and consistency change real results a lot, so treat this as a likely range, not a promise. This is not medical advice.
